subject: Startups
title: Trademark Basics for Startups
description: One-minute skill: Trademark Basics for Startups.

hook.text: A startup called 'StreamLine' launches. Six months later, a larger company with the same name sends a cease-and-desist.

buildup.text: Trademarks protect brand names, logos, and slogans. They prevent confusion in the marketplace.

discovery.text: Filing a trademark costs $250–$350 per class of goods. It's affordable insurance against naming conflicts.

twist.text: Common words are hard to trademark. 'Apple' works for computers but not for fruit. Distinctiveness matters.

climax.text: Do a thorough trademark search before naming your company. Rebranding a growing startup is painful and expensive.

punchline.text: Search the name before you build the brand around it.

quiz.question: Why should startups file trademarks early?
options: It prevents naming conflicts and protects the brand
